# COSCUP x UbuCon Asia 2026 錄取攤位公告／Full List of Accepted Community Booths at COSCUP x UbuCon Asia 2026

## Full List of Accepted Community Booths at COSCUP x UbuCon Asia 2026

COSCUP x UbuCon Asia 2026 Booth now release. See which community you can meet on COSCUP x UbuCon Asia 2026.

### Booth items provided

- One table (180 x 60 cm) and two chairs
*Tables should be shared with other communities if necessary.*
- At least ONE 110V AC socket
*Total power consumption mustn't exceed 550W; bring your own power strip if needed.*

We will provide a more detailed booth specification document in the future, so please keep an eye on your inbox!

**Notice to Community Booth Partners**: The second round of acceptance emails for community booths has been dispatched. Please log into COSCUP’s Pretalx and update your booth application status from "Accepted" to "Confirmed."

If you have any questions, please contact program@coscup.org

## 社群攤位正式錄取名單公布啦～

### 大會提供攤位物品

- 一張桌子（180 x 60 cm）且配有兩張椅子，有可能與其他社群共桌。
- 至少一個 110V 電力插座（總消耗功率 550W 內），建議自行攜帶電力延長線。

日後我們會提供更詳細的攤位規格書供社群參考，再仔細注意信箱喔！
